332943aaf92639b2f9eb7699101c78db.name: Cisrotatedhook synth
332943aaf92639b2f9eb7699101c78db.en: Four gliders collide to build a cis-rotated hook.
332943aaf92639b2f9eb7699101c78db.pt: Quatro planadores colidem para construir um cis-rotated hook.

15bd36926e540d60db64ad9bf42718df.name: Crab synthesis
15bd36926e540d60db64ad9bf42718df.en: Builds the crab from 18 gliders. Martin Grant's first recipe drew on ideas from Brett Berger and Tanner Jacobi, and Chris Cain and Matthias Merzenich refined it within days.
15bd36926e540d60db64ad9bf42718df.pt: Constrói o crab com 18 planadores. A primeira receita de Martin Grant partiu de ideias de Brett Berger e Tanner Jacobi, e Chris Cain e Matthias Merzenich a aprimoraram em poucos dias.

29f637d45955015808f08b2c4aa39966.name: Decapole synth
29f637d45955015808f08b2c4aa39966.en: A glider collision that builds the decapole.
29f637d45955015808f08b2c4aa39966.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o decapole.

205990cdc9fd0b8d73799294abead47a.name: Eater on boat synth
205990cdc9fd0b8d73799294abead47a.en: A glider collision that builds the eater on boat, also called boat tie eater tail.
205990cdc9fd0b8d73799294abead47a.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o eater on boat, também chamado boat tie eater tail.

7fb733a38cbe1b91d7287ae0f766a6f0.name: Eheptomino synth
7fb733a38cbe1b91d7287ae0f766a6f0.en: A set of glider recipes for the E-heptomino, produced with the search tool synthesise-patt.
7fb733a38cbe1b91d7287ae0f766a6f0.pt: Um conjunto de receitas com planadores para o E-heptominó, geradas com a ferramenta de busca synthesise-patt.

22b8cb1a37aa4001ed942a29f72a3edf.name: Fireship synth
22b8cb1a37aa4001ed942a29f72a3edf.en: Eighteen gliders build the fireship; the recipe can repeat every 387 ticks, for either of its two variants.
22b8cb1a37aa4001ed942a29f72a3edf.pt: Dezoito planadores constroem o fireship; a receita pode se repetir a cada 387 gerações, em qualquer uma das duas variantes.

097cdaca0f3360fc87f192e246cfa976.name: Gabriel's p138 synth
097cdaca0f3360fc87f192e246cfa976.en: Twelve gliders collide to build Gabriel's p138.
097cdaca0f3360fc87f192e246cfa976.pt: Doze planadores colidem para construir o Gabriel's p138.

2be99e29d7eaee496590e0f308b47386.name: Griddle and beehive synth
2be99e29d7eaee496590e0f308b47386.en: Sixteen gliders collide to form the griddle and beehive.
2be99e29d7eaee496590e0f308b47386.pt: Dezesseis planadores colidem para formar o griddle and beehive.

1e35b4a5d01612e335441c5f07696633.name: Hectic synth
1e35b4a5d01612e335441c5f07696633.en: Builds hectic out of 26 colliding gliders.
1e35b4a5d01612e335441c5f07696633.pt: Constrói o hectic com a colisão de 26 planadores.

120e274735dc27697f7d1b52dac5f10e.name: Hooks synth
120e274735dc27697f7d1b52dac5f10e.en: Fifteen gliders collide to build hooks.
120e274735dc27697f7d1b52dac5f10e.pt: Quinze planadores colidem para construir o hooks.

0ae778ccdb22e641ce2ca6d00096e463.name: Interchange synth
0ae778ccdb22e641ce2ca6d00096e463.en: Several glider syntheses that build interchanges.
0ae778ccdb22e641ce2ca6d00096e463.pt: Várias sínteses com planadores que constroem interchanges.

005564ffd7017638c3266f32ab4fc4bd.name: Koksgalaxy synth
005564ffd7017638c3266f32ab4fc4bd.en: Eleven gliders collide to build Kok's galaxy.
005564ffd7017638c3266f32ab4fc4bd.pt: Onze planadores colidem para construir o Kok's galaxy.

084d9f52289ee81a03c6ebb5be6bf6a7.name: Loaf synth
084d9f52289ee81a03c6ebb5be6bf6a7.en: Several glider syntheses that produce loaves.
084d9f52289ee81a03c6ebb5be6bf6a7.pt: Várias sínteses com planadores que produzem loaves.

120e6df485bb4c737c2261891b8dc4a0.name: Long long boat synth
120e6df485bb4c737c2261891b8dc4a0.en: Glider collisions that build long long boats.
120e6df485bb4c737c2261891b8dc4a0.pt: Colisões de planadores que constroem long long boats.

3ccf49ebe27ad3bc95eb324ddd98d0d4.name: long4snake synth
3ccf49ebe27ad3bc95eb324ddd98d0d4.en: A glider collision that builds the extra extra long snake.
3ccf49ebe27ad3bc95eb324ddd98d0d4.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o extra extra long snake.

2e7dd1b78445db705e9c72fa381686a4.name: Middleweight spaceship synth
2e7dd1b78445db705e9c72fa381686a4.en: Glider collisions that produce middleweight spaceships.
2e7dd1b78445db705e9c72fa381686a4.pt: Colisões de planadores que produzem naves médias.

160246decaa37c983ab531c430709e49.name: Mold synth
160246decaa37c983ab531c430709e49.en: A glider collision that builds the mold.
160246decaa37c983ab531c430709e49.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o mold.

480bc1e1dc74e691fea9423096038dea.name: Octapole synth
480bc1e1dc74e691fea9423096038dea.en: A glider collision that builds the octapole.
480bc1e1dc74e691fea9423096038dea.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o octapole.

0c4b019136978d8d38794368bfc0e16a.name: P44 pi-heptomino hassler synth
0c4b019136978d8d38794368bfc0e16a.en: Sixty-seven gliders collide to assemble the p44 pi-heptomino hassler.
0c4b019136978d8d38794368bfc0e16a.pt: Sessenta e sete planadores colidem para montar o p44 pi-heptomino hassler.

03d9e1ae46bc6e2dc1dccf118ed4a92f.name: Paperclip synth
03d9e1ae46bc6e2dc1dccf118ed4a92f.pt: Colisões de planadores que constroem paperclips.

047b8c0541b6755b61d94bb4b929ca3b.name: Period-144 glider gun synthesis
047b8c0541b6755b61d94bb4b929ca3b.en: Thirty-five gliders collide to build a glider gun of period 144.
047b8c0541b6755b61d94bb4b929ca3b.pt: Trinta e cinco planadores colidem para construir um canhão de planadores de período 144.

882f24e7a8e6ad44f555bbd5b21b3117.name: Piston synth
882f24e7a8e6ad44f555bbd5b21b3117.en: A glider collision that builds the piston.
882f24e7a8e6ad44f555bbd5b21b3117.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o piston.

54363647dd8d8d37b664db3f359a31ba.name: Pufferfish synth
54363647dd8d8d37b664db3f359a31ba.en: Builds the pufferfish; the recipe is based on a soup that Richard Schank found.
54363647dd8d8d37b664db3f359a31ba.pt: Constrói o pufferfish; a receita se baseia numa sopa encontrada por Richard Schank.

295e38b01755665c1ea8fd22e4f4581a.name: Queen bee synth
295e38b01755665c1ea8fd22e4f4581a.en: A glider collision that builds the queen bee.
295e38b01755665c1ea8fd22e4f4581a.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói a queen bee.

259995116ab82e0d1aff9176edf7fdd4.name: Scrubber synth
259995116ab82e0d1aff9176edf7fdd4.en: Ten gliders collide to build the scrubber.
259995116ab82e0d1aff9176edf7fdd4.pt: Dez planadores colidem para construir o scrubber.

070b38d29fdd42eb0b08623f39edc9c6.name: Shortkeys synth
070b38d29fdd42eb0b08623f39edc9c6.en: Six gliders collide to build short keys.
070b38d29fdd42eb0b08623f39edc9c6.pt: Seis planadores colidem para construir o short keys.

00dcb9c20e7f001955b97b3115cf1304.name: Smiley synth
00dcb9c20e7f001955b97b3115cf1304.en: A glider collision that builds the smiley.
00dcb9c20e7f001955b97b3115cf1304.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o smiley.

0377b42c975bd7a59cccf3e8b3ba750b.name: Snark synth
0377b42c975bd7a59cccf3e8b3ba750b.en: A glider collision that builds the Snark.
0377b42c975bd7a59cccf3e8b3ba750b.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o Snark.

0c1f0c9767d91ef79da31185cb503b55.name: SyringeGtoH synth
0c1f0c9767d91ef79da31185cb503b55.en: A glider collision that builds the syringe.
0c1f0c9767d91ef79da31185cb503b55.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o syringe.

38f4647d2cf4ea6a7cf618efe6a071d6.name: tnosedp6 synth
38f4647d2cf4ea6a7cf618efe6a071d6.en: Thirty-two gliders collide to build the T-nosed p6.
38f4647d2cf4ea6a7cf618efe6a071d6.pt: Trinta e dois planadores colidem para construir o T-nosed p6.

2c59ad96a5977f0dca98759fdd0bfc07.name: Trans-boat with nine synth
2c59ad96a5977f0dca98759fdd0bfc07.en: Several glider syntheses that produce the trans-boat with nine.
2c59ad96a5977f0dca98759fdd0bfc07.pt: Várias sínteses com planadores que produzem o trans-boat with nine.

1bb9e6763462116ad6621219e8ebebab.name: Tripole synth
1bb9e6763462116ad6621219e8ebebab.en: A glider collision that builds the tripole.
1bb9e6763462116ad6621219e8ebebab.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o tripole.

2294cad817240c461855ad2176ed4441.name: Twinbeesshuttle synth
2294cad817240c461855ad2176ed4441.en: Seven-glider recipes for both the cis and the trans twin bees shuttle.
2294cad817240c461855ad2176ed4441.pt: Receitas de sete planadores para as versões cis e trans do twin bees shuttle.

29570a2ad0fbd3e7b8c1084872a5bbef.name: Twopulsarquadrants synth
29570a2ad0fbd3e7b8c1084872a5bbef.en: A glider collision that builds two pulsar quadrants.
29570a2ad0fbd3e7b8c1084872a5bbef.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o two pulsar quadrants.

06f5a8a23b4e0486a6274c298d9154b8.name: Verylonghookwithtail synth
06f5a8a23b4e0486a6274c298d9154b8.en: A glider collision that builds the long long hook with tail.
06f5a8a23b4e0486a6274c298d9154b8.pt: Colisão de planadores que constrói o long long hook with tail.

b07f8102cac29c1aa82cf3909ae85623.name: (p, p+8) prime calculator
b07f8102cac29c1aa82cf3909ae85623.en: Built on the cousin prime calculator, itself derived from Dean Hickerson's primer; it was put together with help from calcyman.
b07f8102cac29c1aa82cf3909ae85623.pt: Baseado na cousin prime calculator, que por sua vez deriva do primer de Dean Hickerson; foi montado com a ajuda de calcyman.

51ce7228d15e5c85cabea71f24c708fd.name: Cousin prime calculator
51ce7228d15e5c85cabea71f24c708fd.en: Derived from Dean Hickerson's primer pattern.
51ce7228d15e5c85cabea71f24c708fd.pt: Derivado do primer de Dean Hickerson.

0cf000eace051b646f3d7d2da949f9f9.name: Infinite glider hotel 4
0cf000eace051b646f3d7d2da949f9f9.en: A compact infinite glider hotel that builds on earlier designs by David Bell.
0cf000eace051b646f3d7d2da949f9f9.pt: Um infinite glider hotel compacto, baseado em projetos anteriores de David Bell.

df62f311ebbdb6195f91ad2f7f68a8bb.name: Mosquito 3
df62f311ebbdb6195f91ad2f7f68a8bb.en: A pattern whose population grows quadratically over time.
df62f311ebbdb6195f91ad2f7f68a8bb.pt: Padrão cuja população cresce de forma quadrática com o tempo.

1f2485116f7de4e9478b0f80d4566c44.name: T log(t)^2
1f2485116f7de4e9478b0f80d4566c44.en: Named for its growth rate: the population grows asymptotically like t log(t)^2 divided by 12(log 3)^2. MWSS pulses from a switched gun reactivate guns left by a stifled breeder.
1f2485116f7de4e9478b0f80d4566c44.pt: O nome vem da taxa de crescimento: a população cresce assintoticamente como t log(t)^2 dividido por 12(log 3)^2. Pulsos de naves médias reativam canhões deixados por um breeder bloqueado.

41070eff512728d0b4d84bae96e16830.name: c2extensiblelineship
41070eff512728d0b4d84bae96e16830.en: Created by Hartmut Holzwart in May 2008.
41070eff512728d0b4d84bae96e16830.pt: Criada por Hartmut Holzwart em maio de 2008.

15a3b063c96a61a114f18399ffa3c2c4.name: Crotchet
15a3b063c96a61a114f18399ffa3c2c4.en: Conway's name for the P-pentomino, one of the 12 pentominoes; it often shows up as a spark.
15a3b063c96a61a114f18399ffa3c2c4.pt: Nome dado por Conway ao P-pentominó, um dos 12 pentominós; costuma aparecer como faísca.

088dbce062d795f36a76cd7f6fa2d294.name: Garden of Eden 3
088dbce062d795f36a76cd7f6fa2d294.en: When found, it was the smallest Garden of Eden known.
088dbce062d795f36a76cd7f6fa2d294.pt: Quando foi encontrado, era o menor Jardim do Éden conhecido.

0c38afe3273efb24b4055e09afd1ccfc.name: Honey bit
0c38afe3273efb24b4055e09afd1ccfc.en: A one-bit memory in Brice Due's OTCA metapixel. Its empty state is a beehive (hence 'honey'); a glider turns it into a block and pond, and a passing LWSS reads the bit, restoring the beehive.
0c38afe3273efb24b4055e09afd1ccfc.pt: Memória de um bit do OTCA metapixel de Brice Due. O estado vazio é uma colmeia (daí o "honey"); um planador a transforma em block e pond, e uma nave leve lê o bit, recriando a colmeia.

1029a4983da0438ead7b8aae27312a64.name: Loaf pull
1029a4983da0438ead7b8aae27312a64.en: A glider strikes a loaf and pulls it back by (3,1), toward the direction the glider came from.
1029a4983da0438ead7b8aae27312a64.pt: Um planador atinge um loaf e o puxa (3,1) de volta, na direção de onde o planador veio.

00b94cb63c79fbe1a09e3e2c18e6401d.name: Overweight spaceship
00b94cb63c79fbe1a09e3e2c18e6401d.en: Shaped like the standard LWSS, MWSS and HWSS, only longer, it falls apart on its own; only with an escort of other ships does it hold together, as a flotilla.
00b94cb63c79fbe1a09e3e2c18e6401d.pt: Tem a forma das naves leve, média e pesada, só que mais comprida, e se desfaz sozinha; só com uma escolta de outras naves ela se mantém, formando uma flotilha.

344fd6779ab0deb19266cd05c184b2ce.name: Pre-pulsar predecessor
344fd6779ab0deb19266cd05c184b2ce.en: A frequently seen shape that turns into a pre-pulsar after four generations.
344fd6779ab0deb19266cd05c184b2ce.pt: Forma frequente que se transforma num pre-pulsar após quatro gerações.

0c55c97412a1158d1a96a45b10c3f3ee.name: Slow glider construction
0c55c97412a1158d1a96a45b10c3f3ee.en: Building an object with a slow salvo: gliders from one side whose exact timing doesn't matter. In 1997 Nick Gotts turned a lone block into a block-laying switch engine with 53 gliders.
0c55c97412a1158d1a96a45b10c3f3ee.pt: Construção de um objeto com uma salva lenta: planadores vindos de um só lado, sem depender do tempo exato. Em 1997, Nick Gotts transformou um bloco num switch engine que deixa blocos, usando 53 planadores.

009cc525be9047e513580834b3735f9f.name: Tail
009cc525be9047e513580834b3735f9f.en: Bolting this four-cell piece onto a still life is a common way to get a larger one.
009cc525be9047e513580834b3735f9f.pt: Encaixar esta peça de quatro células numa vida estática é um jeito comum de obter uma maior.

0d95752bca23f24eb24380e3ddd1276f.name: Triplet
0d95752bca23f24eb24380e3ddd1276f.en: All five possible 3-cell polyplets: the two triominoes plus three shapes that die within two generations.
0d95752bca23f24eb24380e3ddd1276f.pt: Os cinco poliplets possíveis de 3 células: os dois triominós e mais três formas que somem em duas gerações.

251aab0d510be6c744ed5a7e619b8693.name: W-pentomino
251aab0d510be6c744ed5a7e619b8693.en: One of the 12 pentominoes, named by Conway; it commonly evolves into a loaf.
251aab0d510be6c744ed5a7e619b8693.pt: Um dos 12 pentominós, batizado por Conway; costuma evoluir para um loaf.
